description: This file defines the TimesheetTimeFormatAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for retrieving the configuration of the timesheet time format in the OrangeHRM system. It includes a method to get the current time format configuration and stub methods for updating and deleting the resource, which are not implemented.

classes.name: TimesheetTimeFormatAPI
classes.description: API class providing access to the timesheet time format configuration, with methods to retrieve the current format and placeholders for update and delete operations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the current timesheet time format configuration and returns it wrapped in an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the getOne method, excluding the ID parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to handle updating the timesheet time format.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to provide validation rules for the update operation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to handle deletion of the resource.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to provide validation rules for delete operation.
